channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Italy’s veil debate: Why Meloni wants burqas, niqabs banned in schools? How Europe regulates Islamic dress | Explained
item.description: Italy’s center-right coalition government moved to counter the surge of the ultranationalist National Future party, with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni proposing new education laws that would place more restrictions on foreigners and veils.

item.title: NYC Mayor Mamdani announces $131.5 million DoorDash settlement over underpaid delivery workers: Deal explained
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced a $131.5 million DoorDash settlement over delivery worker pay. About 264,000 couriers will receive compensation, while DoorDash will pay $16.7 million in fines to the city.

item.title: Australia tightens visa rules for students, visitors and workers: Key changes explained
item.description: Australia has announced a fresh set of migration measures affecting student, visitor, skilled migration and working holiday visas, with the changes to be rolled out progressively over the next 12 months.

item.title: ‘Feeling burned out’: Bengaluru techie earning ₹35 LPA contemplates 6-month career break, sparks debate
item.description: Despite a lucrative salary and about six years of experience, the techie shared that he felt overwhelmed by the daily grind.

item.title: Brahma AI raises $150 million at $2 billion valuation led by Multiples
item.description: Brahma AI’s latest funding, led by Multiples at a $2 billion valuation, will support R&amp;D, global expansion and talent as the company builds an enterprise AI platform for content and digital humans.

item.title: Why is Trump administration accepting White South African refugees to US again? Here's what we know
item.description: The Trump administration plans to admit 17,500 refugees in FY2027, primarily Afrikaners from South Africa. The administration said they face racial discrimination and persecution; South Africa disputes claims of systematic persecution or genocide against the group.

item.title: Taylor Swift announces ‘Patient Zero’, her first single after wedding; new track to release September 25
item.description: Taylor Swift is set to release her new single ‘Patient Zero’ on September 25, days before she receives the inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors.

item.title: Petrol, diesel prices today, September 23: Check rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: In Mumbai, the retail price of petrol stood at ₹111.21 per litre, remaining unchanged from the previous day.

item.title: Iran War Live: Tehran rejects Trump's 'annihilation' warning, sets Hormuz conditions
item.description: Iran War Live: Trump warns Iran of annihilation but says a deal could be near. Tehran sets conditions to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, while Saudi Arabia restarts its East-West oil pipeline and Gulf states discuss a security framework.

item.title: Hurricane Polo Becomes One of 2026’s Strongest Storms Off Mexico
item.description: Hurricane Polo has become one of the world’s strongest storms this year as it threatens to lash Mexico’s Pacific Coast with heavy rain and winds.

item.title: MrBeast faces backlash over $10 million Ghana project: Here’s how he responded to critics
item.description: MrBeast has defended a nearly $10 million Ghana village project aimed at tackling child labour after criticism over overseas spending. He pointed to his philanthropy in Greenville, North Carolina, including millions of meals distributed in his community.

item.title: Trump says CNN, MS NOW, Politico could return to White House if court rules against media ban
item.description: The remarks come a day before a federal court hearing on the outlets’ lawsuit challenging the administration’s decision. The three media organizations have argued that the restrictions violate their First Amendment rights.

item.title: A Florida artist spent decades creating this bizarre world. Now his family is opening it for Halloween
item.description: Florida artist Lewis VanDercar spent decades transforming his Wesley Chapel property into a world of sculptures, gardens and unusual buildings. His family is now reopening the Warlock House for a Halloween event and October statuary tours.

item.title: Netanyahu-Mamdani clash escalates: Israeli PM vows to ‘tell the truth’ about NYC mayor at UNGA
item.description: Netanyahu is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly on Thursday, with his visit coming amid continued international scrutiny of Israel’s military campaign in Gaza and growing tensions between him and Mamdani over the conflict.

item.title: Binance faces US criminal probe over Iran sanctions violations | What we know
item.description: US prosecutors are investigating Binance over possible Iran sanctions violations and whether the crypto exchange knowingly allowed prohibited trading. The probe adds to the company’s history of US regulatory scrutiny following its 2023 guilty plea.

item.title: US national Van Dyke pays ₹5.5 lakh compounding charge; may return to US: What it means for NIA case & UAPA probe
item.description: The FRRO proceedings have resulted in the compounding payment relating to the Foreigners Act offences, while the legal position concerning the alleged UAPA offences remains part of the pending proceedings.

item.title: Hurricane Polo reaches Category 5 strength: When it is likely to make landfall and which areas to be worst affected?
item.description: Polo jumped from Category 1 to the strongest Category 5 classification on the Saffir-Simpson hurricane scale in less than a day. The hurricane was packing sustained winds of around 160 mph (260 kph) and could strengthen further, the NHC said

item.title: ‘Ridiculous or reasonable?’ Gurgaon couple reveals ₹1.2 lakh monthly spending breakdown
item.description: The couple said their biggest monthly expense is the ₹36,000 they pay towards rent and maintenance for their 3 BHK home.

item.title: Obamacare crackdown: Why Trump administration is removing 750,000 people from health insurance rolls
item.description: The Trump administration plans to remove hundreds of thousands of people from Obamacare rolls over alleged improper enrollment, while suspending brokers. The move comes as healthcare costs rise and millions remain dependent on ACA marketplace coverage.

item.title: Trump at UNGA: US President again claims credit for India-Pakistan ceasefire - ‘Saved 30 million lives’
item.description: Trump's latest remarks came despite New Delhi's longstanding position that the ceasefire was reached through direct communication between the two countries' military leaderships, rather than through third-party mediation.

item.title: Turkish President Erdogan raises Kashmir issue at UNGA again, calls for India-Pakistan dialogue under UN framework
item.description: The remarks came in the presence of Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. Erdogan's latest intervention marks a continuation of Ankara's repeated references to Kashmir at the UN.

item.title: Trump signs US-Denmark-Greenland agreement: What the new US security deal means
item.description: The deal falls short of Trump's demand for the United States to acquire Greenland as a US territory, but grants Washington expanded military access and security rights on the mineral-rich island.

item.title: CDSCO flags indiscriminate use of painkillers and antibiotics
item.description: The Drugs Controller General of India advises that all non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and antibiotics must be sold and distributed only on the prescription of a registered medical practitioner or specialist.

item.title: Trump’s UNGA speech: ‘Big decision’ on Iran, economic isolation call and 8 other key points
item.description: Trump also said he believed the US and Iran could reach a deal after the November midterm elections, while insisting that Tehran would never be allowed to obtain a nuclear weapon.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere cause of death revealed: Actor died from fentanyl overdose, coroner says
item.description: Hayden Panettiere died from an accidental overdose involving fentanyl and several other drugs, the Greenville County Coroner’s Office confirmed. The 36-year-old actor was found unresponsive in South Carolina on 16 August.

item.title: Reaping profits by YouTube and discarded materials: This couple built 2,500-sq-ft home for $40,000, sold it for $290,000
item.description: Jessica Patrzyk, 34, and her husband left their life in rural Worth, New York, where they had operated several businesses, including a coffee shop, retail shops and a tarot reading service

item.title: Trump couldn’t get Greenland. So he secured permanent US military rights instead | Here's what the deal is about
item.description: The agreement aims to strengthen US and NATO security in Greenland amid concerns over Russia and China, but key legal details remain undisclosed.

item.title: Trump's Iran war is nearing 7 months. Here's why his UN speech matters for oil prices and markets
item.description: Trump’s UNGA speech comes as the Iran war nears seven months, with oil prices, Hormuz and global markets in focus.

item.title: Vijay Mallya gets Bombay HC warning over posting court documents on social media
item.description: The court issued the warning after Enforcement Directorate (ED) lawyer said that Mallya had uploaded the agency's affidavit on his social media accounts even before it was formally submitted before the court.

item.title: UNGA 2026 Highlights: Trump rejects ‘globalist scheme’ to control AI, says should be called ‘super intelligence'
item.description: UNGA 2026 Highlights: President Trump has begun his address to the United Nations. 'I can report to you with pride that America is back', the US President said.

item.description: The ED has also provisionally attached shares held in Pitti's demat account valued at ₹59.60 crore under the PMLA.

item.title: Are GLP-1s causing blindness? Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly face lawsuits in US
item.description: The condition, known as nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), affects the optic nerve and can cause sudden, painless loss of vision.

item.title: Rajasthan CET 2026 exams rescheduled over local body polls, 40 lakh aspirants affected: Check revised dates
item.description: Rajasthan CET 2026 candidates who have registered for the examinations should take note of the revised schedule and plan their preparation accordingly.

item.title: Bay of Bengal depression likely to intensify, hit Andhra-Odisha coast
item.description: The weather system comes as the southwest monsoon begins its annual withdrawal from northwest India.

item.title: Zoho Sridhar Vembu warns engineers over AI coding: ‘Driving too fast in a fancy new car'
item.description: In a post on X, Sridhar Vembu said engineers should make use of AI tools but continue to exercise their own technical judgement and understand the work being produced.
